product.summary: SafePal self-custody browser-extension wallet for supported desktop browsers.
product.notes: Current first-party download page explicitly lists Chrome and Edge distribution; launch date is left unset pending a separate reviewed launch source.

events.title: SafePal Extension Wallet officially launched
events.description: SafePal announced the official launch of its browser extension wallet on August 19, 2022.
events.notes: The historical launch announcement listed Chrome, Firefox and Microsoft Edge. Current supported-browser status is governed separately by current distribution evidence and is not inferred from this 2022 event.

evidence.title: SafePal Download Center
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution page confirming the active SafePal App, SafePal Extension Wallet, and supported SafePal S1, S1 Pro, and X1 hardware-wallet lines.

evidence.title: The SafePal difference, now available on Chrome: Introducing SafePal Browser Extension Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal announcement explicitly identifies August 19, 2022 as the official launch of the SafePal browser extension wallet.
